GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat half off 3 Wide No Cover , ridden along turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, found little, dropped out # 3 Wide trip
Jumped Ok Straight To The Front No Pace On Settled Down 1 then 2 Lengths Clear allowed to dictate terms to Straightening Up Soon After challenged run ended 300 - # own terms, weak
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover until approaching the 600m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Ridden Along Went Forward from Outside to be in the Lead and on the rail x 800m, Set  Good Pace to Turn Straightening Up 1 Lengths Clear Collared x 300m, gone x 100m, - # used up early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr was reminded of her obligations to ride her mount out fully to the end of the race.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast Ridden Along Good Pace on Settled Down 7th 3 Wide with a trail 3 Lengths stuck in between runners Turning for home , Under Pressure x 300m kept trying without threatening - (t/t/1st) # never gave up
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 200m shifted out and away from runner and bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths Ridden Along Went Forward Settled Down = Lead Inside same to straightening up Soon After Under Pressure run ended 300 was # weak once beat
Jumped Fast Went Forward Settled Down 1 Lengths Clear challenged Straightening Up Beaten off x 200m, # not up to it
Jumped Ok comf Went Forward Settled Down 1 Lengths Clear held together same to straightening up challenged x 200m dueled to 100m, Couldn'T Go On - # led, gave all

Jumped Ok Ridden Along Went Forward Settled Down 3 Lengths Clear Good Pace on, led x 4 Lengths @ 500m Under Pressure Turning for home run down Near the line, Went Too Hard (b/1st n/r/off) # gave big sight
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 50m shifted in abruptly, obliging its rdr to stop riding and straighten. Rdr reported he had to make some use of his mount in the early stages to obtain the lead, however with the addition of blinkers for the first time, the gelding then raced keenly throughout the early stages and would not settle.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out Hard Ridden Went Forward from Outside Settled Down 2nd Outside 1 Lengths again Hard Ridden x 500m, gone @ 200m, faced # breeze, caved in
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. Rdr reported his mnt was inclined to lay out at various stages of the race. He said the gelding did not run out the 1550m journey, and consequently weakened in the straight. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward from Outside Settled Down 1/2 Lengths 2nd Outside Good Pace on, faced breeze into Lead Turning for home run down x 100m Sound Effort - Pace Suited Swoopers - # not run to suit
